def is_costas(perm):
    n = len(perm)
    vectors = set()
    for c1 in range(n):
        for c2 in range(c1+1, n):
            dc = c2 - c1
            dr = perm[c2] - perm[c1]
            vec = (dc, dr)
            if vec in vectors:
                return False
            vectors.add(vec)
    return True

perm = (0, 2, 3, 1, 4)
print("Is Costas?", is_costas(perm))
print("x[2] =", perm[2])

vectors = []
for c1 in range(n):
    for c2 in range(c1+1, n):
        dc = c2 - c1
        dr = perm[c2] - perm[c1]
        vectors.append((c1, c2, dc, dr))
print("Vectors:")
for v in vectors:
    print(v)
print("All distinct?", len(set((dc, dr) for _, _, dc, dr in vectors)) == len(vectors))
